## 26.2 IssueofInterimCertificates

The percentage referred to in Sub-Clause 26.2 (b) of Conditions of Contract for retention is the percent stated in the Form of Agreement and/or the Letter of Acceptance (if any).

Modify percentage shown in paragraph sub-clause 26.2 (b) (i) to be as stated in Sub-Clause 26.1 (b) (i).

In Sub-Clause 26.2 (h), replace the 30 days with 15 days.

## Addnewparagraph(J)asfollows:

- () The Employer retains his right to withhold (15%) fifteen percent of the monthlypayment in the event theContractor failed to deliver the following documentation:
- 1.Material submissions scheduled through the monthbased on the approved log for the Contract Administrator approval.
2. Shopdrawingsscheduledthroughthemonthbasedonthe approved log for the Contract Administrator approval.
- 3.Asbuiltdrawingsscheduledthroughthemonthbasedonthe approved log to be provided for the Contract Administrator approval.
4. Progress update throughout the month based on the approved constructionschedule.
- 5.Removal of faultyexecuted works.

The Employer, in addition to the above, retains his right to withhold thcmonthlypaymentcertificatein theevent theContractorfailedto submitandobtainapprovalforthefollowingdocumentation:

- Submissionand approval ofthe completeconstructionbase line scheduleinaccordancewithsection01310ofDivisionIofGeneral requirements including butnot limited toMan-Power histogram, staff mobilizationchart,andWorkinPlacehistogram.
- Submission and approvalof QualityControl and Quality Assurance program.
- Submission and approval of Safety and SecurityPlan.
- Submission and approvalof InsurancePoliciesas per the requirementsofSub-Clause12.9.

Suspension of the monthly payment shall be lifted upon the submissionof thesaiddocumentby theContractor and approvalby payment due to the Contractor failure to meet this requirement will be thesoleresponsibilityof theContractor.
